purpose: Use freed workers for distinct credible measured-data questions while functional-model discovery continues. Completed prior packets remain frozen and integrated; do not manufacture a finding or repeat their analyses.

imaging_discovery.question: Do public sarcoma imaging collections expose authenticated EMC scans or processed quantitative imaging measurements with relevant controls/conditions sufficient for a new tissue-structure or treatment-state inference?
imaging_discovery.initial_sources: Actual clinical manifests and primary studies for TCIA Soft-tissue-Sarcoma and QIN-SARC, followed only by a directly relevant source trail. Reuse the completed negative CPTAC-SAR eligibility evaluation.
imaging_discovery.scope: First evaluate every individual histology and condition in the named collections. Before any image or phenotype-value pilot, freeze one precise biological question, prior art, controls, unit of independence, uncertainty and defeat condition. Existing qualitative myxoid MRI appearance or a classifier demonstration is not new knowledge. No bulk DICOM downloads before identity, value and storage feasibility are established.

liquid_biomarker.question: Do public EMC circulating-DNA/RNA or other quantitatively measured blood-marker observations linked to tissue or serial disease measurements permit a new useful inference about shedding or monitoring?
liquid_biomarker.scope: One bounded primary-source pass across circulating fusion/cfDNA and sarcoma liquid-biopsy studies, with relevant clinical measurement reports. Authenticate every EMC donor, assay and condition, including historical aliases. Distinguish detection capability from clinical sensitivity and tissue genotype from plasma measurement. Do not treat already published marker presence as discovery. Before new quantitative analysis, freeze the consequential unanswered question, overlap, comparison, uncertainty and defeat condition. If no useful measured inputs survive, finish with explicit gaps.

ownership: Each worker retains its existing reserved, separate worktree; new writes only in its named round3 subdirectory. Do not edit any frozen source packet or shared queue.
storage: Total round budget320MiB unchanged including copies/recovery; use metadata and small processed inputs first. Measure free space before downloads and leave10GiB. A necessary larger scientific pilot requires a fresh storage estimate and amendment, not a silent exclusion.
reporting: Brief actionable worker updates and final source/analysis/coverage paths; detailed searches remain in packets. Reassess validity and scientific value separately.
